entries.back_en: "Would you use force against innocent women and children!?"
"Why does it matter to you?[02]They don't matter...[01]Their lives mean nothing."
entries.note: Equivalente; 'if I do' implícito mas ok.

entries.back_en: "Every life matters![02]Every life has meaning.[02]How can you say that!?"
"...Because [you had] luck once, don't think you can talk down to me like that."
entries.note: 'Porque sorte uma vez' está sem verbo/incompleto; faltou 'teve sorte' e 'Só porque'.

entries.back_en: "You don't have to remind me![02]But the orders don't say he has to come in one piece, right?[02]I think I can make him a bit more...cooperative, if you get me!"
Watching what happened, I knew that something was not right in the world.
"Is that so!?[02]I've heard the only reason there is no permanent truce between us is because Ludia keeps arguing over the details!"
"I wonder...Is it because he's not whole?[02]I mean, maybe because of that he's...unstable or something."
"It's not g-good t-t-to t-t-tie up women."
